"Let me tell you a story, of love and first letters.
Tell you a story of romance and betrayal.
Patricia was an honest girl, well loved by many.
Admirers flocked to her from near and far, but none of these men could win her heart.
Never one to mope, she threw herself into her weaving.
Days went by, and her work slowly improved, becoming the envy of weavers everywhere.
Yet no one expected her to draw the attention of a beautiful spider goddess.
Irramak, mother of spiders, began writing messages for the young weaver in spider silk.
Soon the young weaver began to respond in kind, weaving messages into her tapestries.
Eventually, the goddess decided to send one of her aspects to meet the weaver.
Visitors had continued to come to the weaver, yet none had won her heart till a small maiden presented her with a roll lid the goddess' own silk.
In honor of her patronage, the weaver created her most beautifully stunning tapestry yet.
Loving the gift, the goddess blessed the weaver and took her into her care, weaving peacefully for eternity."
